assumptions_checked: Local operator forms gE/(RT), differences that function, then subtracts the center log-activity ratio; one point is not the dataset-average score.
Gibbs-Duhem product-rule derivation is at fixed temperature and pressure; general-path excess enthalpy and volume terms are stated.
Isothermal VLE neglects the excess-volume pressure contribution; real isobaric data require independent excess enthalpy for a corrected local verdict.
Synthetic generator excess enthalpy is not independent calorimetry; Herington empirical allowance does not replace that property.
Normalized area uses nonnegative area magnitudes and is distinct from a signed integral; missing endpoints require an explicit assumption.
Localized cases can meet both aggregate criteria while retaining a visible residual peak; denser synthetic sampling adds no experimental measurements.
Van Ness-type fit is a teaching NRTL parameterization; pressure percent and vapor-composition percentage-point units remain distinct.
Consistency, model reproduction, homogeneous-feed curvature and global equilibrium stability remain separate claims.
A globally supporting tangent, distinct phases and feasible material balances are required; phase classifications do not predict nucleation or separation speed.
Illustrative .20/.80 tie-line endpoints are not the actual A=3 coexistence endpoints.

Lab03 exports include shared workspace controls. Study workspace · reopen and compare cases accepts Load studies or a comparison JSON, then Restore beside a case; students recalculate or refit for fresh results. Recorded imported results do not substitute for a fresh calculation.
Lab04 is a hypothetical fixed-temperature, fixed-pressure binary liquid model; A is dimensionless, with no assigned physical temperature, vapor calculation or kinetic prediction.

For the stable z=.02 feed, displayed .0707/.9293 values are binodal reference boundaries, not two phases present. Phase fractions and chemical-potential equality between present phases are not applicable.
For Lab04, Restore changes the input controls but can leave result cards from the previous calculation. Find equilibrium must be pressed to obtain fresh results.
Lab04 minimum tangent-plane distance is a separate diagnostic from the Gibbs-energy decrease; small numerical residuals alone do not prove global stability.
